test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 8 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.**

The tin-roofed house __gave up__ during the terrible storm.
solution:
The correct answer is **'gave way'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• There is a **phrasal verb** error in the underlined part.
 
• **Gave up **is a phrasal verb of **"give"** which means **to cease making an effort or to admit defeat**. This does not fit the context of the sentence.
 
• The meaning of the other options - 
 
 
• **Gave away - **give something freely as a gift or donation.
 
 
• *Example *- *I **gave away** all my books.*
 
 
 
• **Gave way - **(of a support or structure) be unable to carry a load or withstand a force; collapse or break.
 
 
• *Example *- *His aching legs **gave way**, and he almost fell.*
 
 
 
• **Gave over - **allow oneself to be taken over by emotion or addiction. 
 
 
• *Example - I **gave myself over** to the joy of gliding down a long ski run.*
 
 
 
 
 
• From the above meanings, it is clear that "**gave way" **will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. 
 
• Thus, **option 3 **is the correct answer. 

 

**Correct sentence__* - ****The tin-roofed house **__gave way__** during the terrible storm.*
